transitionTimeline.observer: Opt-in test-side MutationObserver and CSS transition listeners; no application runtime instrumentation
transitionTimeline.clocks: Browser performance.now and Node hrtime/wall clock retained separately; no alignment asserted
limits: MutationObserver callback times are not exact DOM mutation timestamps.
Transition listener times are callback delivery times and do not reconstruct every animation frame.
Playwright's internal toHaveCSS matcher retry schedule remains unobserved.
findings: Transient under one worker and under four light peers: semantic state became transient while the observed transform was -288px; transitionrun/start/end were later observed and the helper settled at identity transform. Start/end callback timestamps were equal at available clock precision, so continuous progress was not measured.

Pinned under one worker: transition events began with a translated transform and transitionend was observed at identity geometry about 2.5 seconds after transitionstart; the pinned state remained open. This is a delayed event observation, not proof of its cause.
No transitioncancel or return-to-peek event was recorded in these probe captures.
Reduced-motion probe reported transitionDuration 0s, no transition events, and identity transform; the helper passed.
transitionTimeline.defaultDiscovery: The .diagnostic.ts file is not matched by the default Playwright test pattern; the dedicated config selects only this probe.

rawRetention.policy: Only the sanitized normalized capture summary is committed. Its source report SHA-256 values are recorded in that artifact; the original reporter outputs are not replayable from the PR.

hypothesisClassification.caseA_expectedInProgressTransition: observed in the bounded open-state probes: semantic openness preceded fully open geometry, then the helper returned after identity geometry; animation frame-by-frame progress is not proven
hypothesisClassification.caseB_transitionStarvationOrPersistentIn: possible under historical broad-suite conditions, but not independently distinguished by M7S captures
hypothesisClassification.caseC_stateReversal: not observed in the new probe captures; cannot exclude unobserved transient states in historical runs
hypothesisClassification.caseD_geometryContractMismatch: not supported; the documented desktop visual-ready contract is identity geometry, which the helper checks
hypothesisClassification.caseE_insufficientEvidence: applies to the historical M7R failures because they lack transition lifecycle timestamps and the bounded M7S conditions did not reproduce that transform assertion
